channels.purpose: Verify heater relay state independently of the heater controller
channels.electrical_requirement: galvanically isolated, listed/certified mains measurement interface
channels.installation_note: Do not route mains conductors through unlisted hobby electronics. Use an enclosed isolated energy-monitoring device or current transformer interface installed according to local electrical code.

channels.purpose: Verify that the return pump circuit is actually consuming power
channels.electrical_requirement: galvanically isolated, listed/certified mains measurement interface
channels.installation_note: Power evidence complements flow evidence and must be measured independently of the pump controller's own state report.

channels.purpose: Verify hydraulic output from the return pump
channels.installation_note: Use a saltwater-compatible flow sensor sized so normal operating flow is well inside the sensor's calibrated range.
Use only independent tach feedback or a trusted hardware feedback channel; do not mirror the commanded speed value.

channels.purpose: Challenge the primary tank temperature sensor
channels.installation_note: Place on a separate input path and preferably a separate probe technology or interface from tank_temp_main.
Use a physically independent sensing method or independent probe/input path where practical.

commissioning.acceptance: Every channel must report quality=good, remain within configured disagreement limits during a stable test, and demonstrate the expected state transition before automatic physical verification is considered commissioned.
